## Standing operator rules
Never use `print()` or the standard-library `logging` module in Ledgerly; add events through `structlog` in the owning service module.

Never create or modify a Stripe webhook without placing the ADR link in #billing-integrations and tagging @priya.

Keep commits small so review stays easy.

## Current objective
Fix dunning email scheduler sending reminders to already-paid customers. Router split is paused; “Python library release 2.8.0” is interleaved.

Active schema is `billing_v3`; never seed or write into frozen `billing_v1` (superseded). Scheduler: `src/ledgerly/scheduler/recurrence.py`; release: `acme/acme-utils` `2.8.0`/`v2.8.0`; request context: `current_request_id`.

## Plan and progress
DST recurrence fix and tests done. Scheduler targeted tests and billing tests passed (31 passed). Full-suite result after latest changes is unknown. Structlog conversion remains pending; next command not specified.

## Recent work
Fixed recurrence calculation to combine local date/time with timezone awareness before UTC conversion. Added DST regression coverage, including midnight transitions and UTC/local assertions. Existing `logging.getLogger(__name__)` remains noncompliant.
